title: Witness interfaces for additive Postnikov exact couples
statement: For abelian A and B with D(A), and a functor T:D(A)→B, define the normalized truncation-layer comparison, initial exact-couple comparison, additive iterated D/E functors with image and homology squares, stationary-entry and half-plane object properties, stabilized-page data, spectral-sequence data, natural filtered abutment data and its transport property. These are exactly the witness interfaces in PostnikovAdditiveExactCoupleData. No witnesses are chosen by these definitions. Here the ambient notions are [def-sp-abelian], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], [def-sp-homological-functor], [def-sp-exact-couple], [def-sp-spectral-sequence], [def-sp-filtration], [def-sp-convergence], and the half-plane condition of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence]; the canonical terms and arrows are [def-per-postnikov-truncation-couple-terms].
